title: Gregor Grey
html_source:
Gregor Grey: Irish painter
Born: fl.1880
Died: 1911
Known for: rural figure, genre, and animal painting
Gregor Grey exhibited every year at the Royal Hibernian Academy from 1877-1911. His works tended to be on a rustic theme and featured quaint, anecdotal titles.
